llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: it mimics the official Intimissimi store using a similar-looking but unofficial '.at' domain, offers unusually large discounts and heavy urgency messaging, and provides no clear or verifiable company info. The WHOIS records do not disclose the registrant, and the site offers huge discounts on many items—tactics commonly used by fake online shopping scams. The real Intimissimi website does not use this domain. These factors, in combination, match several of the outlined scam signals.
